intro.t: A church power struggle in miniature.
b: Commendation of one man's hospitality, and complaint about another who likes being first and excludes those he dislikes.

1.t: A man who loves to be first and puts people out of the church. John names him, which is unusual and instructive.

1.ctx: A short personal letter from the elder to Gaius, a faithful church member.
1.mean: The elder prays that all may go well with Gaius and that he may be in good health, as it goes well with his soul.
1.big: The elder cares for his friend's whole wellbeing, body and soul.
1.diff: Verse 2 is sometimes used to teach that God promises believers prosperity and health. In context it is simply a customary greeting wishing a friend well.

1.ctx: Travelling missionaries relied on the hospitality of local believers.
1.mean: The elder commends Gaius for his faithful hospitality to brothers who were strangers, and asks him to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God. We ought to support such people, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
1.big: Supporting those who carry the gospel makes believers partners in their work.

1.ctx: A church power struggle. Diotrephes apparently led a house church and had refused to receive the elder's letter or the travelling teachers the elder sent.
1.mean: The elder says Diotrephes, who likes to put himself first, does not acknowledge the elder's authority, spreads malicious talk, refuses to welcome the brothers, and puts out of the church those who do. Do not imitate evil but good. Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone.
1.big: Love of pre-eminence damages the church; faithful service earns a good name.
1.diff: Whether Diotrephes was a false teacher or simply ambitious and controlling is not stated.

1.ctx: The closing, very similar to 2 John. 'The friends' echoes Jesus' words calling his disciples friends (John 15:14–15).
1.mean: The elder hopes to see Gaius soon and speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you; greet the friends, each by name.
1.big: The church is a community of friends known to one another by name.
